10 REM! INTEGER I
20 DIM B$(1,10)
30 W%=Y%:IF (W% AND W%) THEN 170:Z%=-((-D%(Z%,B%))):READ I:PRINT I OR I
40 FOR I=(I) TO (B%):POKE D%(ABS(W<>Y%),W%),1000
50 DATA -2.5:FOR W=(Y) TO (VAL("TASC"))
60 XY=FRE(N2$):PRINT POS(W$)
70 XY=TAN(NOT ((I-1E3))):XY=D%(W%,((Z% OR D%(537,I)))-Z%*W):PRINT Z%--Y%;FRE(RIGHT$("A",B%<256)),"";
80 FOR W=(D%((39)/XY,B%)) TO (7674=((Q1 AND XY))<>D%(W%>W%,486)):COLOR=FRE(STR$(W))^NOT 40
90 HCOLOR=B%:PRINT W,W$+B$(Y%,B%)+MID$(A$(Y%),ASC(A$)),XY,
100 Z%=X+Y:XY=FRE(Z%)+POS(W%*951=Z%-Z%<-((D%(I,5)<=W))):Q1=W
110 FOR Y=(W%) TO (Z%-3):Z%=39:I=Y%*B%
120 N2$=RIGHT$(STR$(-10),XY+((I OR X))):B%=((1000-7))^I-3:IF (B% OR B%) THEN 140:X=-D%((3.14159),Y%)
130 READ A$(-0)
140 B%=Q1/23012:W=FRE(B%)+POS(Q1):CALL D%(.001<Y,I<=Y)>=((LOG(194) OR -D%(I,W%))):Z%=I:Y=Z% AND Z%
150 FOR W=(Z%) TO (((W% AND Q1))*((Y*D%(B%,Z%)))*NOT ((3.14159<=Z%))) STEP (ATN((2))*((TAN(Y)/W%)))
160 W%=3.14159:Q1=FRE(W%)+POS(256)
170 XY=FRE(N2$+"A"):PRINT POS(A$):A$=N2$
180 N2$=B$(-Q1 OR Z%<=W%,(Q1)):Y%=5466:PRINT MID$(""+A$(2),Y)+"123",
190 READ W$
200 PRINT EXP(32767);"TASC"+MID$("",39)+W$+LEFT$("123",D%(B%,10));:Q1=FRE(CHR$(XY)):PRINT POS(W$)
210 PRINT SQR(B%),39,FRE(-662) AND LEN(A$(40000)+A$(Y%));
220 ON X-2*Y+W% GOTO 160,50:W$=""
230 IF (Z%) THEN A$=A$+A$(0/Y%)
240 W=W%:X=W OR W:Y=((PEEK(1675) OR -X))+B%
250 W%=10:IF (W% OR W%) THEN 30
260 REM! CLEAR COMMON:READ XY
270 READ W,B%
280 B%=(XY):Y=B% AND B%
